risk_description:
The front collision sensors may not have been fitted correctly. This can cause the safety belt restraint system to malfunction, 
leading to serious injuries to the occupants. In the event of an accidental deployment of the front airbag, control of the vehicle may be lost, creating a  risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
